run_grpc_server: run a gRPC server on localhost:23333 with four data transmission modes
create_unary_method: create a unary-unary gRPC method that receives one request and returns one response
create_client_streaming_method: create a client streaming gRPC method that receives multiple requests and returns one response
create_server_streaming_method: create a server streaming gRPC method that receives one request and returns multiple responses
create_bidirectional_streaming_method: create a bidirectional streaming gRPC method where both client and server send multiple messages
